ledger_text: **Multi-target damage rule** (one arc hits N enemies — full damage each? falloff toward the tip?).
text: One arc hitting N enemies deals the same full Damage object to every one of them — no falloff toward the tip and no split — each enemy hit at most once per slash (gotHitFlag), broad-phased by a ±200 px horizontal window, and the combo counter increments by the number of DISTINCT enemies hit, not by hits.

lane_impact: L-combat-core, L-enemies-ai, L-items-equipment (weak points are literally paperdoll slots, so the weak-point table and the equipment layer table are the same table).
ledger_text: **Hit-registration window** (instant at release vs an active sweep an enemy can dodge into/out of).
text: Hit registration is instantaneous at slash resolution, evaluated by walking the released polyline point-by-point — there is no swept active window an enemy can dodge into or out of — and resolution walks the paperdoll part list FRONT-to-BACK so the topmost part struck decides the hit (which is the actual mechanism behind 'shielder legs / undead heads' weak points).

ledger_text: **Sell price is NOT flat per item** — it scales with rarity/level (same sword 5c and 25c). Don't encode flat-per-type.
text: Sell price is (1 + affixModifierCount) x 10 for items of weight >= 10 and x 5 below that, with anything itemID < 3000 selling for a flat 1 — it does NOT scale with rarity or level, and it is identical in both builds.

text: The SPEED→cooldown transfer function is linear and hard-capped: cooldowns are multiplied by 1 − min(SPD,300)/300 × 0.5, so SPEED 300 is the cap and buys exactly a 50% cooldown reduction; the SPEED buff multiplies SPD by 1.5 before the clamp.

 — StatsManager.as:1881 'basedamage = getPlayerStats(STAT_ATTACK) + findBonusStat(STAT_ATTACK) + itemdata.mindamage;' · :1875 broken → 'basedamage = getPlayerStats(STAT_ATTACK) + findBonusStat(STAT_ATTACK) + 1;' · :1903 'return itemdata.maxdamage - itemdata.mindamage;'

lane_impact: combat-core — the KNOWN-KNOWN damage formula is at best incomplete: weapon contribution is a min/max roll and there is a hard slashUsage floor of 48; no stance multiplier appears in this function. PARTIAL because the PvE damage path was not read.
ledger_text: - **Damage math:** Physical = (ATK + WeaponDMG) × stanceMult; Heavy defender Defense ×0.8 (one way); Critical = 1.3 × Physical; Chi-skill damage is a **flat per-level constant** that ignores defense (except Undead/Red Oni).
text: Weapon damage is a RANGE, not a single WeaponDMG term: minDamage = attack + item.mindamage with damageRange = maxdamage − mindamage, and slashUsage is clamped to a floor of 48 — but this is the PvP duelist init path, so whether the PvE NPC path applies the same rule is not established here.

lane_impact: L5 (UI/HUD) + items — a builder who initialises fresh items to uses=0 makes every item permanently Unbreakable. Fresh wearable items must start at uses=1 ('Well-Maintained'); uses=0 is reserved for the unbreakable class.
quote: public function gotUsed(num:int = 1) : * { if(this.uses == 0) { return; } ... this.uses += num; }  /  public function repair(num:int) : * { if(this.uses == 0) { return; } this.uses -= num; if(this.uses <= 0) { this.uses = 1; } }  /  if(this.uses == 0) { conditionStr = LangManager.getString(639); } else if(this.uses == 1) { conditionStr = LangManager.getString(392); }   [639='Unbreakable', 392='Condition: Well-Maintained']
text: uses == 0 is a sentinel meaning the item never degrades, not 'brand new': gotUsed() returns immediately when uses==0 and repair() clamps to a floor of 1, so 0 is unreachable once an item has ever worn — which is why the ladder's first branch is 'Unbreakable'.

quote: Simulated exactly as written (++counter; y += speed; speed += 2): close frame 15 y=-30, close frame 16 y=0 (shutters MEET), close frame 17 y=0 DOACTION. open frame 15 y=-210, open frame 16 y=-240 DOACTION. Cumulative displacement after n frames is n(n-1), which is 240 at n=16 — NOT (n-2)(n-1). BLACKOPEN at :98-107 has no counter test at all.
